nodes.label: SessionContext
nodes.desc: Front door for queries; wraps one shared SessionState behind an RwLock.

nodes.label: DataFrame
nodes.desc: Lazy columnar API; collect() finally drives execution.

nodes.label: SessionState
nodes.desc: Per-query catalogs, config, analyzer, optimizer and planner.

nodes.label: SessionStateBuilder
nodes.desc: Fluent assembly of customized sessions with extra rules or planners.

nodes.label: DFParser
nodes.desc: Extends sqlparser with CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE, COPY and EXPLAIN.

nodes.label: statement_to_plan
nodes.desc: Dispatches each parsed statement to its planning routine.

nodes.label: SqlToRel
nodes.desc: Core AST-to-logical-plan converter backed by a ContextProvider.

nodes.label: sql_to_expr
nodes.desc: Rewrites SQL expression trees into typed Expr nodes.

nodes.label: ListingTableFactory
nodes.desc: Creates table providers for paths referenced by CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE.

nodes.label: LogicalPlan
nodes.desc: Relational algebra nodes: Projection, Filter, Aggregate, TableScan.

nodes.label: LogicalPlanBuilder
nodes.desc: Programmatic construction of plans used by the DataFrame API.

nodes.label: Expr
nodes.desc: Typed expression tree of columns, literals, aggregates and windows.

nodes.label: TableScan
nodes.desc: Plan leaf that names a TableProvider plus projections and filters.

nodes.label: Analyzer
nodes.desc: Pre-optimization passes such as type coercion and grouping rewrites.

nodes.label: Logical optimizer
nodes.desc: Applies push_down_filter, optimize_projections and the other logical rules.

nodes.label: Built-in rule catalog
nodes.desc: Ordered catalog of 2 analyzer, 27 logical and 21 physical rules.

nodes.label: QueryPlanner hook
nodes.desc: Extension point that can replace default physical planning.

nodes.label: DefaultPhysicalPlanner
nodes.desc: Lowers the optimized LogicalPlan into an ExecutionPlan operator tree.

nodes.label: ExecutionPlan
nodes.desc: Trait; execute(partition) returns a SendableRecordBatchStream.

nodes.label: PlanProperties
nodes.desc: Schema, output ordering and distribution attached to every node.

nodes.label: AggregateExec
nodes.desc: Partial/final grouped aggregation over group-value tables.

nodes.label: SymmetricHashJoinExec
nodes.desc: Streaming hash join that emits matches before inputs finish.

nodes.label: SortExec
nodes.desc: Lexicographic sort that spills intermediate batches to disk.

nodes.label: TopK
nodes.desc: Bounded priority queue behind LIMIT-style queries with dynamic filters.

nodes.label: FilterExec
nodes.desc: Selective predicate operator over record batches.

nodes.label: MemoryStream
nodes.desc: Turns in-memory partitions into record-batch streams.

nodes.label: spawn_buffered
nodes.desc: Moves a stream onto a tokio task with a bounded batch buffer.

nodes.label: SpillManager
nodes.desc: Writes batches to disk spill files when memory is exhausted.

nodes.label: Spill IO codec
nodes.desc: Arrow IPC encode/decode that replays spilled data as streams.

nodes.label: ParquetSource
nodes.desc: Parquet scan re-export with row-group pruning and pushdown.

nodes.label: ListingTableConfigExt
nodes.desc: Infers file format and schema from listed object-store paths.
